notes: 300 squishy stages of jumping, climbing and timed obstacles is Obby & Platformer, and each world is explicitly a tower, so course-tower with the genre P6 and its P2 for stacked platforms. The answers settle the scale question by choosing five separate themed towers linked by a teleporter at each summit, which is several maps that cannot share one surface, so P4 is added on top of the shape's route; P4 is not shipping yet, so this is the deferral to note rather than a silent downgrade to one continuous spiral. Options come straight from the prompt's own lists rather than being inferred: the butter cube maze is obstacle-maze, conveyors and lollipop poles and noodle swings are obstacle-moving, the giant presses are obstacle-timing, pancake and cotton candy climbs are obstacle-climb, the invisible-squishy bonus stage is obstacle-guess, soy sauce lakes and slime rivers and the Lava Squish stage are hazard-kill, checkpoints every five stages are checkpoint-respawn, the pets and secret rooms are collectible-nodes, and the VIP area with the spin wheel is social-hub. I read the squishy lakes and rivers as lethal surfaces rather than swimmable water so nothing volumetric enters the route, and treated rebirth, badges, trails and seasonal updates as progression with no layout footprint.
